title: Real-Time Face Recognition, Object Detection and Counting
description: A real-time computer vision application that uses webcam input to perform face recognition, object detection, and object counting. Built with OpenCV and deep learning techniques to analyze live video streams accurately and efficiently.

title: Bluetooth Controlled Robot Car with Edge-AI Vision
description: A distributed robotic system combining Arduino-based Bluetooth motor control with Raspberry Pi–powered real-time computer vision. The robot uses MobileNet SSD for object detection, streams annotated live video via Flask MJPEG, and demonstrates efficient separation of control and perception for edge-AI robotics applications.

title: ProgressNest
description: A full-stack platform for learners to track progress, share resources, and engage with a community. Features dashboards, achievements, blogging, and a secure Django backend with SQLite integration.

title: Smart Home Security System
description: An Arduino-based smart home system with gas and IR sensors for entry counting, leak detection, smoke alerts, secure vault access, day-night sensing, and automatic lighting for enhanced safety.

title: NEXORAA
description: NEXORAA is a weather and travel assistant powered by AI. It provides real-time forecasts, interactive maps, air quality monitoring, and personalized travel recommendations with seamless deployment on Vercel.

title: Personal Portfolio Website
description: A responsive personal portfolio website built with React and Tailwind CSS. Showcases projects, blogs, achievements, and skills with a modern design and smooth user experience.

title: Vulnerability Scanner CLI
description: A Python-based CLI tool that scans for misconfigurations, outdated services, and weak controls using Nmap, Regex, and OSINT. Designed for pentesting and quick security assessments.

title: Obstacle Avoiding Robot v2
description: An advanced obstacle-avoiding robot powered by Arduino, integrating ultrasonic sensors for distance measurement, L298 motor controller for precise motor driving, and a servo motor for dynamic sensor rotation. Designed to detect and avoid obstacles in real-time, ensuring smooth autonomous navigation.

title: Automatic Smoke & Gas Leakage Detection and Exhaustion
description: A safety-focused circuit designed to detect smoke and harmful gas leakage using the MQ2 sensor. The system triggers a buzzer alarm for immediate warning and activates a DC 5V exhaust fan via a transistor-driven relay, ensuring rapid ventilation and hazard mitigation. Built with simple yet reliable components for effective real-time protection.
